texts.local: Your shop runs on this computer: products, orders and settings are saved here. Phones on the same Wi-Fi can open it. For customers ordering from home, this computer has to stay on and be reachable through a Cloudflare Tunnel.
texts.remote: Use this when StoreKart already runs on your server (for example Unraid with Cloudflare Tunnel). This computer opens the staff screens, the sales counter or the self-order screen.
texts.remoteHint: Your store's web address, e.g. https://shop.yourdomain.com or http://192.168.1.10:3080
